my beloved {ff 00 00 02}Porpoise{ff 00 00 00}, I still
have a long way to go{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
I need {ff 00 00 02}5 more{ff 00 00 00} {ff 00 00 07}parts {ff 00 00 00}to
complete repairs on my
spaceship.
{07 06 00}They have to be around
here somewhere{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 00 00}I know the technology of my
people must seem strange
and frightening to you...
{07 16 00}...but I beseech you to set
your no-doubt enormous
mind to finding my {ff 00 00 07}parts{ff 00 00 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Otsustades mu armsa
{ff 00 00 02}Porpoise'i{ff 00 00 00} seisu järgi on
mul veel pikk tee minna{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Vajan veel {ff 00 00 02}5{ff 00 00 00} {ff 00 00 07}osa{ff 00 00 00}, et
oma kosmoselaeva remont
lõpetada.
{07 06 00}Nad peavad siin kuskil
olema{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 00 00}Tean, et mu rahva tehnika
peab sulle tunduma veider
ja hirmutav...
{07 16 00}...aga anun, et paneksid
oma kahtlemata hiiglasliku
mõistuse mu {ff 00 00 07}osi{ff 00 00 00} otsima!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Greetings, my oddly formed
friend.

I still need {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} of the
missing {ff 00 00 07}parts{ff 00 00 00}. With your
help, they'll all be mine!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Tervitused, mu veidra
kujuga sõber.

Puudu on veel {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00}
{ff 00 00 07}osa{ff 00 00 00}. Sinu abiga saavad
need kõik minu omaks!

messages.en:
{07 1d 00}Oh!{01 00 00 0f 00} You've recovered some
of my ship's {ff 00 00 07}parts{ff 00 00 00}, I see!
messages.et:
{07 1d 00}Oh!{01 00 00 0f 00} Ma näen, et oled
leidnud mu laeva {ff 00 00 07}osi{ff 00 00 00}!

messages.en:
{07 1d 00}Oh!{01 00 00 0f 00} Have you retrieved some
of the missing {ff 00 00 07}parts{ff 00 00 00} to my
spaceship?
messages.et:
{07 1d 00}Oh!{01 00 00 0f 00} Kas oled leidnud mu
kosmoselaeva puuduvaid
{ff 00 00 07}osi{ff 00 00 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}To show my appreciation for
all that you've done, I want
you to have this.
{07 14 00}Consider it a token of
friendship between our
two planets.
It is an alien artifact of
incredible rarity and value.{01 00 00 0f 00}
I hope you like it.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Et näidata oma tänulikkust
kõige eest, mida sa tegid,
tahan, et sa selle saaksid.
{07 14 00}Pea seda sõpruse märgiks
meie kahe planeedi
vahel.
See on uskumatult haruldane
ja väärtuslik tulnukaese.{01 00 00 0f 00}
Loodan, et sulle meeldib.

messages.en:
{07 19 00}Now, I must set myself to
work repairing my trusty
{ff 00 00 02}Porpoise{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 14 00}I intend to return to the
stars early tomorrow. {07 15 00}It's
going to be a long night.
{07 14 00}But I hope that you will
be here in the morning
to see me on my way!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Nüüd pean asuma parandama
oma ustavat
{ff 00 00 02}Porpoise'i{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 14 00}Kavatsen homme vara
tähtede juurde naasta.
{07 15 00}Tuleb pikk öö.
{07 14 00}Aga loodan, et sa oled
hommikul siin, et mind
teele saata!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Hm. Yes.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} With this, I
should be able to repair
my ship's cooling unit.
My {ff 00 00 02}Refridgerizer{ff 00 00 00} keeps my
ship's engines...and my
beverages...quite cool.
{07 14 00}I am overcome with
gratitude!{01 00 00 0f 00} Thank you, my
globe-headed friend.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Hmm. Jah.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Sellega saan
parandada oma laeva
jahutusseadme.
Mu {ff 00 00 02}Külmutisaator{ff 00 00 00} hoiab mu
laeva mootorid...ja mu
joogid...kenasti jahedana.
{07 14 00}Olen üle ujutatud
tänutundest!{01 00 00 0f 00} Aitäh, mu
kerapeaga sõber.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Hm. Yes! {07 1d 00}These parts will
help me out tremendously!

With these parts, I can fix
my {ff 00 00 02}Inhibition Inhibitor{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 13 00}It allows me to perform
acts of great valor against
my better judgment!
{07 14 00}I'm so grateful!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Thank you so much!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Hmm. Jah! {07 1d 00}Need osad
aitavad mind tohutult!

Nende osadega saan korda
oma {ff 00 00 02}Pidurduspiduri{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 13 00}See võimaldab mul sooritada
suure vapruse tegusid vastu
tervet mõistust!
{07 14 00}Olen nii tänulik!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Suur aitäh sulle!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Hm. Yes.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Let's see.
{07 1d 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}fantastic!{01 00 00 0f 00} These parts
will serve me well.
I should be able to fix my
ship's{01 00 00 05 00} {ff 00 00 02}Whimsy Drive{ff 00 00 00}, allowing
me a more fanciful flight.
{07 14 00}You have my gratitude,
my small, potato-headed
alien friend.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Hmm. Jah.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Vaatame.
{07 1d 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}suurepärane!{01 00 00 0f 00} Need osad
tulevad mulle kasuks.
Peaksin suutma parandada
laeva{01 00 00 05 00} {ff 00 00 02}Kapriisiajami{ff 00 00 00}, mis
lubab kapriissemat lendu.
{07 14 00}Sa oled mu tänu väärt,
mu väike, kartulipeaga
tulnukasõber.
